review:
Bonus Bunnies is a 4x4 cartoon slot with an unusually soft maths model for Nolimit City. When a bunny lands with a wild, the wild explodes vertically, and horizontally too if two bunnies land, turning a single wild into a cross of them.

Three bonus bunnies start Carrot Link Spins: three spins where landing a carrot or an enhancing bunny resets the counter while values build up. Nolimit rates it Medium volatility, with a 6,950x cap and an 18% hit rate. A cheerful, slightly odd game.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
